colours.name: Forest Green
alts: Dino Rider green dinosaur-shaped spring rider for kids

data.description: A Forest Green dinosaur sits on a spring in the Dino Spring Rider. Children climb on its back, hold on and bounce or rock, often roaring along as they go. Dinosaurs are a favourite theme with young children, so the Dino Rider is popular in play schools and society toddler areas. Like our other spring riders, it gives small children a gentle way to practise balance close to the ground. It pairs well with our Aeroplane Rider, which shares the same Forest Green colour, if you want a matching set. The roto-moulded dinosaur comes with a 3-year warranty, and the spring with 1 year. Ask us to add it to your layout.

items.pText: A Forest Green dinosaur sits on a spring in the Dino Spring Rider. Children climb on its back, hold on and bounce or rock, often roaring along as they go. Dinosaurs are a favourite theme with young children, so the Dino Rider is popular in play schools and society toddler areas. Like our other spring riders, it gives small children a gentle way to practise balance close to the ground. It pairs well with our Aeroplane Rider, which shares the same Forest Green colour, if you want a matching set. The roto-moulded dinosaur comes with a 3-year warranty, and the spring with 1 year. Ask us to add it to your layout.

The dinosaur body is roto-moulded and does not rust in wet weather. Its spring is fixed to the ground by grouting or a self-standing base. Leave room around the rider for its movement, use rubber flooring underneath, and inspect the spring and handholds regularly.
